test_item_verbatim: · When STATUS_BH_BCM2.CmdIgnSts = [RUN], RVC image active, Shift Lever chagne to Reverse Gear_Stat.info = [REVERSE] > Reverse_Deb, the Head Unit shall continue to display RVC image and switch to the Automatic Display mode.

tcs.tc_title: Atl-Mi, automatic activation on STATUS_CCAN4 reverse gear
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. PROXI Rear_View_Camera = 1 (Present)
2. The Head Unit is in the RUN power state
3. No camera image is shown
4. The last selected audio source is active
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Send CAN: STATUS_BH_BCM2.CmdIgnSts = 4 (RUN)
2. Send CAN: STATUS_CCAN4.ReverseGearSts = 0 (Not_Inserted)
3. Send CAN: STATUS_CCAN4.ReverseGearSts = 1 (Inserted)
4. Read the Head Unit display and check that the rear view camera image is shown in Automatic Display Mode
tcs.expected_result:
1. The Head Unit stays in the RUN power state
2. No camera image is shown and the previous content remains
3. The rear view camera image appears once the Reverse_Deb debounce has elapsed
4. The rear view camera image is shown in Automatic Display Mode
tcs.split_reason: Atl-Mi, automatic activation on STATUS_CCAN4 reverse gear
tcs.test_item:
· When STATUS_BH_BCM2.CmdIgnSts = [RUN], RVC image active, Shift Lever chagne to Reverse Gear_Stat.info = [REVERSE] > Reverse_Deb, the Head Unit shall continue to display RVC image and switch to the Automatic Display mode.

(Atl-Mi, automatic activation on STATUS_CCAN4 reverse gear)

reasoning: 驗證目標與 NR1L-RVC-003 同為排檔進入 R 後之自動顯示，惟為 Atl-Mi 半邊；verbatim 取 SYS-RA-VF551_V3-266（VF551_V3 §1.10.2.3，對應 Fastack 376），其點火訊號逐字為 STATUS_BH_BCM2.CmdIgnSts（P363_BH-CAN [07338]_3A_R2.dbc BO_ 1132，VAL_ 4 "RUN"）。排檔觸發：來源之 Gear_Stat.info 為內部訊號，依 §8.7.5(f) 轉為 Atl-Mi 側可觀察之 STATUS_CCAN4.ReverseGearSts（P363 與 637MCA 兩本 DBC 皆有，BO_ 996，VAL_ 0 "Not_Inserted"／1 "Inserted"），與 VF551_V33 之寫法一致。**刻意不採 CAM-03 §2 所指名之 TRANSM2.ShiftLeverPosition** —— 該訊息不存在於 forms/ 之四本 DBC，無 raw 值與 VAL_ label 可引（A-CA23／DR-CAM-f）；VF551_V42（637）以該名書寫同一觸發，待 DBC 補件後須複核本列對 637 是否仍成立。PROXI 僅 Rear_View_Camera = 1 (Present)，三本 Atl-Mi XLSM 之 Y 欄實測皆為 1；Atl-Mi 無 Rear_View_Camera_Type 參數，故不入 Pre-Condition。
